skills.skill_desc:
Moskov's Basic Attacks can penetrate the target and deal <font color="fba51f"> (+68% Total Physical Attack)</font>-<font color="fba51f"> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies behind them (scales with hero level).
Each Basic Attack hit reduces the cooldowns of <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Walker</font> by 0.8s and <font color="a6aafb">Spear of Misery</font> by 0.8s.

Moskov teleports to the target location, increasing his Attack Speed to 1.15 times its normal value for 3s. During this time, his Basic Attacks deal <font color="fba51f"> (+10% Total Physical Attack)</font> damage to enemies behind the primary target.

Moskov launches a powerful strike at the target enemy hero or creep, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, knocking them back, and revealing their position for 2s.

If the target collides with an enemy hero when knocked back, they'll both take 200<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and be stunned for 1.2s. The target is also stunned for the same duration if they collide with a wall.

After a short delay, Moskov throws the <font color="a6aafb">Spear of Destruction</font> in the target direction, dealing 340<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. Enemies behind the first enemy hero hit take 10% extra damage. All enemies hit are slowed by 50% for 1s. The slow duration increases with the spear's travel distance, up to 3s.
When <font color="a6aafb">Spear of Destruction</font> hits an enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and resets <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Walker</font>'s cooldown.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Moskov casts <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Walker</font> from the shadow's location (shares a cooldown with Skill 1).
